Academic Context  
Hawa and I collaborated on a project at NebulaTech where she led the redesign of our user authentication system. Her approach blended theoretical rigor with practical constraints, balancing security requirements against scalability needs. She often referenced distributed systems principles from her coursework, which helped align our team’s technical decisions with long-term architectural goals.  

Working Relationship  
We’ve worked closely on several SaaS projects, including a microservices refactor that reduced latency by 30%. Hawa’s ability to distill complex problems into actionable steps made her a reliable collaborator. She’s also mentored junior engineers, sharing her expertise in REST API design without assuming prior knowledge.  

Research Ability  
Hawa’s strength lies in her methodical problem-solving. When we faced a PostgreSQL bottleneck in our analytics pipeline, she proposed a hybrid indexing strategy that cut query times by 40%. She also built a Python-based monitoring tool that integrated with AWS CloudWatch, giving our team real-time insights into system performance.  

Broader Strengths  
Beyond technical skills, Hawa’s work ethic is exceptional. She’ll stay late to debug a production issue or refactor legacy code to improve maintainability. Her REST APIs are clean, well-documented, and rarely cause integration headaches for other teams.  

Recommendation  
Hawa’s technical depth and collaborative mindset make her a strong fit for any SaaS team. Her hands-on experience with Go, AWS, and microservices—combined with a knack for simplifying complex systems—will add tangible value. I’d welcome the chance to discuss her further.
